TUM Boring – Innovation in Tunneling e.V. is a team from the Technical University of Munich (TUM), consisting of 60 highly motivated students who have come together to work towards a greener future in which we spend less time in traffic. Update: Won 1st place in the Not-A-Boring Competition in September 2021.
